integrity: Finite classification proved by a complete exact integer-partition census and independently checked witness subset sums. Bibliographic originality is conditional on examined published work and targeted searches, not globally certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite statement for equal census sizes and integer hypergeometric sample sizes; does not cover replacement sampling, unequal totals, continuous interpolation, field-study uncertainty or actual observed frequencies of crossings. General multiple-crossing existence is prior work.
title: Sixteen individuals: the sharp double-crossing threshold for ecological rarefaction
